comments.author: Sharon M.
comments.body: I agree that newsprint has an advantage with portability and resolution. But affordability? Hmmm. Regular price of the Washington Post is $88 for 26 weeks, or $176/yr for 7-day-a-week delivery. If you keep your computer for 3 years and buy a cheap no-brand (or build your own), not such a huge difference between $528 for the home-delivered Post and an eMachine.
